purpose: Review a finite issuer operating-license, statutory permit, public-service concession, franchise, natural-resource tenure and regulated-capacity-right lifecycle domain before opening source rows, registry or filing text, right values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.environmental_boundary: Campaign165 freezes emissions, resource efficiency, environmental compliance and externalities. An environmental permit is one domain-specific compliance instrument, not the issuer's general statutory license, public-service concession, resource tenure, route, spectrum, quota or operating-right lifecycle.
repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes product approvals, capacity commissioning, patents and R&D milestones. Approval of a product or facility does not establish the legal holder, territory, exclusivity, term, renewal, transfer, performance obligation, suspension or revocation of an operating right.
repository_evidence.commercial_terms_boundary: Campaign169 freezes product prices, regulated tariffs, average selling prices and sales terms. A tariff or customer contract may affect concession economics but does not establish the statutory instrument, authority, service territory, duration, renewal or compliance state.
repository_evidence.tax_boundary: Campaign173 freezes tax qualification and compliance. A tax incentive, ruling or concession changes fiscal treatment; it does not grant the underlying right to operate a mine, route, spectrum band, utility network, public service or licensed business.
repository_evidence.lease_boundary: Campaign175 freezes contractual use of assets and right-of-use accounting. A lease grants asset use from a counterparty, whereas an operating license or concession requires a statutory authority, legal instrument, regulated scope, term and public-law compliance chain.
repository_evidence.enterprise_ma_boundary: Campaign177 freezes corporate transaction and control-transfer state. An operating right may transfer in a deal, but acquisition consideration and control transfer do not prove the authority's consent, license assignment, continuity, renewal or post-closing compliance.
repository_evidence.productive_asset_boundary: Campaign178 freezes owned productive assets and capital projects. Owning or building a facility does not prove permission to operate it, an allocated service territory, extraction tenure, regulated capacity quota or continued license validity.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current license list or concession note cannot be projected backward without initial grant, amendment, expansion, renewal, expiry, transfer, change-of-control approval, inspection, breach, cure, suspension, revocation, appeal, correction and first-public histories.

right taxonomy separating ordinary business license, sector operating permit, public-service concession, franchise, authorization, certificate, exploration right, extraction right, spectrum, route, slot, quota, service area and exclusive or nonexclusive mandate

jurisdiction, governing statute, legal instrument number, authority level, regulated activity, product or service scope, geography, facility, resource, frequency band, route, capacity and quota semantics
term start, commercial-operation date, expiry, extension, renewal option, renewal application, holdover, automatic renewal, competitive rebid and remaining-life identity
exclusivity, competition protection, minimum service, universal-service, quality, coverage, capacity, production, investment, local-content, employment and other performance obligations
upfront fee, recurring concession fee, royalty, revenue share, minimum guarantee, price or tariff linkage, performance bond, restoration security, currency, tax and payment schedule semantics
assignment, transfer, subcontracting, encumbrance, collateral, change-of-control consent, merger continuity, affiliate use and termination-compensation identity
inspection, reporting, compliance, breach, notice, cure period, penalty, restriction, suspension, revocation, surrender, force majeure, dispute and appeal outcome semantics

consolidation scope, gross-versus-net presentation, unit and currency, restatement and missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, pending, expired, suspended, revoked, surrendered, true zero quota, zero fee and perpetual-right semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer, subsidiary, authority, instrument, facility and territory identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, term, scope, obligation and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: statutory_operating_license_grant_renewal_suspension_and_revocation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer statutory operating-license state linking grant, regulated scope, effective term, amendment, renewal, inspection, restriction, suspension, revocation, surrender and appeal to the historical legal holder.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted point-in-time history freezes authority and instrument identity, legal holder and security mapping, regulated scope, term, renewal, inspection and enforcement chain, corrections and trading-session availability across the full 2019-2023 issuer universe.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: public_service_infrastructure_concession_franchise_and_service_territory_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer public-service or infrastructure concession state covering award, service territory, exclusivity, term, tariff linkage, investment and service obligations, rebid, extension, termination and compensation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete concession-level history connecting grantor, operator and territory to award and effective dates, performance obligations, fees, tariff terms, amendments, renewal or rebid, transfer, termination, correction and first-public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: natural_resource_exploration_extraction_tenure_and_production_quota_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer natural-resource operating-right state linking exploration or extraction tenure, resource and geography, approved work program, production quota, royalty, restoration obligation, extension, suspension and surrender.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves license boundary, resource and reserve taxonomy, working interest, holder and subsidiary identity, work and production obligations, quota, royalty, environmental dependency, transfer, expiry, restoration and public revision history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: regulated_spectrum_route_slot_service_area_and_capacity_allocation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer allocation state for spectrum, transport route, airport or port slot, service area, licensed capacity, production quota or another scarce regulated operating entitlement.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time registry links scarce entitlement, authority, frequency or route, geography, quantity and unit to holder, allocation method, utilization obligation, transfer restriction, renewal, withdrawal, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_approval_patent_environmental_permit_lease_contract_tax_asset_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing product, intellectual-property, environmental, lease, commercial, tax, asset, transaction or security-price state relabeled as an operating-right lifecycle.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Product approval, patent, environmental permit, lease, customer contract, tariff, tax qualification, productive asset, acquisition or security-price path does not identify the general statutory instrument, holder, authority, territory, regulated scope, term, renewal, transfer, suspension or revocation; renaming it would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: license_count_remaining_term_renewal_expiry_fee_quota_direction_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of license count, remaining term, renewal, expiry, fee, royalty, quota, territory, exclusivity, compliance event or operating-right age against assets, revenue, peers or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing more or fewer rights, longer or shorter remaining term, grant versus renewal, fee or quota normalization, sector subset, successful renewals only, threshold, lag or event window before base source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_license_concession_tenure_quota_and_compliance_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer operating-right score across statutory licenses, concessions, natural-resource tenure, scarce regulated allocations and compliance or renewal outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before any component has a complete point-in-time source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct operating-right lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; product, environmental, lease, contract, tax, asset, transaction or security-price relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
